verdict.rationale: Kong's evidence shows automation tooling: decK is described as a CLI for API Lifecycle Automation (APIOps) that orchestrates and automates configuration, and the gateway can be driven by declarative config or the Admin API, so it could be scripted into external pipelines. Nothing in the pack shows a native way to define automations that run autonomously in the background, so this needs extra tools such as a CI runner or scheduler. Missing for 10: native background/scheduled automation or agent-run workflows, triggers, autonomous execution model, and documentation or hands-on evidence of such a feature.
